description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and legal status of properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
